purpose: Define Tier as derived competence/trust evidence requiring the canonical threshold of at least three recommendations and three Projects at that Tier, subject to MeritCore policy.

semantics.purpose: Define Tier as derived competence/trust evidence requiring the canonical threshold of at least three recommendations and three Projects at that Tier, subject to MeritCore policy.

semantics.identity_rule: Each Tier evaluation has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.threshold_rule: Tier qualification requires at least 3 qualifying recommendations and 3 qualifying Projects at that Tier under the active canonical MeritCore policy.
semantics.project_rule: Qualifying Projects are exact Project identities/evidence.
semantics.recommendation_rule: Qualifying recommendations are exact recommendation identities/evidence.
semantics.derived_rule: Tier is derived MeritCore state, never directly self-assigned.
semantics.negative_rule: Reviewed negative evidence may reduce Tier according to explicit policy.
semantics.decay_rule: There is no generic time-decay of Tier/evidence; recency matters only when a competence criterion explicitly requires it.
semantics.authority_rule: Tier does not grant AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
